method: Rendered PNGs inspected in Codex; companion SVGs use the same Matplotlib figures.
scope: Visual legibility and displayed scientific scope, not experimental efficacy or numerical validation.
findings: All three figures have readable axes, titles and keys, with no material overlap or clipped content.
Electrical figure separates measured charge, assumed lumped polarization and residual recovery; the voltage gate is labeled chosen.
Pressure figure preserves failed authority, recovery overshoot and paired four-seed ranges.
Motor figure is prominently CONDITIONAL with UNQUALIFIED assumed delivery, and separates practice from all-pulses-OFF assessment.
Report explains separate motor panel color scales and idealized post-washout state reset.
Insignificant SVG end-of-line spaces normalized; all PNG bytes remain identical to the inspected renders.
